sections.heading: Pros
sections.text:
Her Ultimate conversion mechanic is meta-defining, being absurdly strong in its value offering.

 Allows for better combo routes on many teams owing to her stun duration extension.

 Well-rounded buff offering, making her less susceptible to stat saturation.

sections.heading: Review
sections.text:
Dialyn is a Physical Stun Agent who can convert other units' Chain Attacks into Ultimates, all the while providing hefty buffs and extending stun durations that allow for brand new combos.
 The bar under her portrait in combat tracks her "Positive Reviews". This has a cap of 120, and regenerates either passively - at a rate of 0.6 seconds - or whenever the Heavy Attack portion of her regular EX Special string hits enemies - at 7.5 per hit. When the gauge reaches 90, it will change colour and stock a "Customer Complaint" point.
 This Customer Complaint point can also be stocked when using an Ultimate, and by holding Basic Attack while one of them is in stock, she will consume it to use her EX Special: Get Lost! - an alternate EX Special that won't use up any Energy and apply a sizable amount of Daze. To keep things simple, this can be referred to as her "Hold Basic EX Special".
 Depending on how many Positive Reviews Dialyn has, different things can happen. If she is under 90, then it will trigger a reverse Quick Assist. If she is at or above 90, then this will forcefully trigger a Chain Attack regardless of the enemy state, so it can be done even when enemies are out of stun!
 After triggering a Chain Attack window (the little menu where you select the next character to Chain Attack with) via certain moves, namely her Quick Assist, Chain Attack or Hold Basic EX Special, she will consume 60 points of Positive Reviews and convert the selected character's Chain Attack into their Decibel Ultimate.
 If the Chain Attack is triggered forcefully through the Hold Basic EX Special (so when enemies are out of stun, or when the stun bar isn't rainbow), then it will consume 90 points instead of 60 for this conversion. It isn’t recommended to do this though, as it can be difficult to keep up with her resource requirements, so try to always use it when there are Chain Attacks left to trigger.
 By constantly using EX Specials to build Daze and Positive Reviews, then triggering Chain Attacks through her Hold Basic EX Specials or other moves, Dialyn can massively increase a team's total damage output by giving them far more Ultimates than they'd otherwise get in a run!

sections.heading: Core Passive & Additional Ability:
sections.text:
Dialyn's Core Passive is what encompasses much of what has been covered above: it outlines how she gains Positive Reviews, how she gains Customer Complaint points and the Ultimate conversion effect.
 There are a few extra bits to her Core Passive though. The first is that Dialyn gets 2 Combat Impact for every 1% of CRIT Rate over 50% , maxing out at 100 extra Impact when at 100% CRIT Rate. When coupled with Dialyn's low base Impact, this means that Impact % bonuses - be it from D6 or Stunner W-Engines - are not as good on her as Daze %. Do refer to the Build section for recommendations on this.
 She also applies a 30% Stun DMG Multiplier increase and extends stun durations by 2 seconds when the last hit of her regular EX Special string, "Paper" lands on enemies. This means that most characters don't have to worry about not having the time to fit in multiple Ultimates in a stun window, as Dialyn provides more time with which to land them.
 As for her Additional Ability, it activates on Attack or Rupture Agents, and it increases the CRIT DMG of all her EX Specials by 50%, while also making all of her regular EX Specials deal additional damage based on the preceding character's stats, scaling with the Attack stat for Attackers and Sheer Force for Rupture Agents.
 This means that team order matters for Dialyn, as she does contribute a decent amount of personal damage. Placing her after an Attacker or Rupture Agent is needed to get full benefit, but isn't absolutely necessary to get value out of her.
 The last, and most important part, of her Additional Ability, is a team-wide 40% DMG Bonus after casting her own Ultimate or any of her EX Specials, called "Overwhelmingly Positive". This lasts 15 seconds at first, but if the duration of the buff is under 35 seconds, it can be extended by landing more of them, with each hit increasing it by 10 seconds.

sections.heading: Special:
sections.text:
Before covering the rest of her kit, it's important to understand Dialyn's EX Specials.
 There's the aforementioned "Get Lost!", which consumes 1 Customer Complaint point and no Energy, but she also has 3 regular EX Specials. These are the bulk of her Positive Review and Daze build, and cost 25 Energy each.
 They are "Rock", "Scissors" and "Paper", with each linking to the next when cast in succession. They don't need to be used straight away though, as there is an 8 second window to cast the next one. You're free to swap out of Dialyn or use other moves between casts.
 After Rock and Scissors, pressing Basic will let Dialyn link into an alternate Basic Attack. Rock leads to alternate Basics 1 and 2, with Scissors leading to alternate Basics 3 and 4.
 Dialyn's regular Special has very poor stats across the board and is rarely worth using.

sections.heading: Basic Attack:
sections.text:
Dialyn's Basic Attacks are rather underwhelming, with unremarkable damage, Daze and Energy values. Her alternate Basic Attacks though (those accessed after regular EX Specials) can be decent.
 A string of:
 EX Special Rock

 Alternate Basic 1 & 2

 EX Special Scissors

 Alternate Basic 3 & 4

 Is an effective way of on-fielding Dialyn. The total Daze build per second she gets from spamming EX Specials vs interspersing them with alternate Basic Attacks isn't very different, but using them can help extend Dialyn's field-time and build a bit of extra Energy.

sections.heading: Dodge:
sections.text: Dialyn's Dodge Counter is alright, but nothing particularly outstanding. It does have decent Energy gain for the time it takes, so it can be used if needing a little extra for an EX Special.

sections.heading: Assist:
sections.text:
Despite it being one of the longest Assist Follow-Ups in the game, it also has the highest Daze multiplier as of the time of her release.
 Given how slow it is, you should be mindful of its long animation lock, but the high Daze that it provides makes it a worthwhile option to use if needing Daze and lacking in Energy to sustain EX Specials.
 Her Quick Assist isn't very good, but it is one of the 3 ways that she can activate her Ultimate conversion if it triggers a Chain Attack, so something to keep in mind.

sections.heading: Chain & Ultimate:
sections.text:
Dialyn's Chain has rather mediocre damage and isn't particularly fast, but it also isn't terribly slow and has a decent amount of Anomaly application, which can help with Decibel management in fights.
 It is, however, one of the 3 ways that Dialyn can activate her Ultimate conversion and likely to be one of the most commonly used. As long as she isn't the last one to use a Chain Attack, she will trigger a Chain Attack window with it.
 Her Ultimate has the lowest Daze build value out of all Agents at the time of her release and it isn't all that fast either, but it does stock a Customer Complaint point.
 As Dialyn gets a Customer Complaint both from hitting 90 Positive Reviews and from her Ultimate, juggling between them means more uses of her Hold Basic EX Special, which more than makes up for its lacklustre Daze.

sections.heading: How to play
sections.text:
Dialyn is a very flexible Agent: she can be played mostly on-field or off-field, so long as you are able to sustain the Energy generation she needs to build Positive Reviews for every stun.
 In simple terms, all that one needs to do is make sure to cast at least one full string of her regular EX Special, so Rock, Scissors and Paper. Landing Paper is very important, as that is how her Stun DMG Multiplier increase and duration extension are applied.
 The earlier she uses an EX Special, the better, as that applies her Overwhelmingly Positive 40% DMG Bonus buff to the whole team. As you can stagger her EX Special casts 8 seconds apart, it's perfectly fine to use an EX Special despite not having the full 75 Energy required for all 3 consecutively, as long as enough can be built before the timer runs out after each cast.
 Once all buffs are up and debuffs are applied, you would split your focus between building enough resources on your main damage dealer (such as Zhu Yuan shotshells, Evelyn Burning Embers, Yixuan Technique Points, etc.) and making sure that Dialyn gets 90 Positive Reviews in time for stun.
 With her Signature W-Engine, she can be mostly kept off-field for its Energy Regeneration bonus and brought in occasionally for EX Specials. Without it, you may need to make use of her alternate Basics between EX Specials to have enough resources.
 Once Stun begins, make sure to use one of the attacks that can trigger the Ultimate conversion to use up her Positive Reviews and go into a stun burst combo.
 The easiest way to achieve this is usually do:
 Trigger a Chain Attack with any character

 Chain Attack on Dialyn

 Chain Attack to your damage dealer (this is upgraded/converted into an Ultimate)

 The more optimal way of initiating stuns though, is through:
 Hold Basic for EX Special: Get Lost!

 Chain Attack to your damage dealer (this is upgraded/converted to an Ultimate)

 Chain Attack on a second character

 Chain Attack on your main damage dealer

 As Ultimates don't count as Chain Attacks, this allows for you to get both an Ultimate conversion and still get your damage dealer's Chain Attack off!
 After the stun ends, it's rinse and repeat. Don't take too long between EX Specials to maintain her 40% DMG Bonus, apply her debuffs with Paper, and keep a close eye on Dialyn's resources so that you have enough Positive Reviews before every stun.

sections.heading: Synergy
sections.text:
Below we list only the most important synergies for Dialyn . The character can work with others if you know what to do and how to use them.

 Ye Shunguang - With every Ultimate cast by Ye Shunguang generating 6 Qingming Sword Force points, Dialyn's Ultimate conversion is one of the most accessible ways to get into the Enlightened Mind State. To top it off, the 30% Stun DMG Multiplier increase from Malicious Complaint applies out of stun with Ether Veil: Verdict, meaning that Dialyn's buff offering is not only strong, but consistent. Her low EX Special cost also makes it easy to have King of the Summit buffs up for every burst period, and fast Heavy Attacks allow for easy double Chain Attacks while in Enlightened Mind State if needed. All put together, Dialyn is an invaluable partner who allows Ye Shunguang to be at her best.
 Yixuan - Dialyn is a perfect match for Yixuan teams. In the out of stun period, she has a low field-time commitment, allowing Yixuan to build resources without sacrificing Daze build. When in stun, Dialyn's Stun DMG Multiplier buff and duration extension do wonders at maximising Yixuan's damage output, which is further amplified by her Ultimate conversion, allowing for 3 Yixuan Ultimates in a single stun (2 Decibel, 1 Technique Point). The combination of high Daze, buff value and the raw damage increase that additional Ultimates bring make her among Yixuan's best teammates.
 Yidhari - Dialyn is Yidhari's best Stunner regardless of fight. It is true that Dialyn's DMG Bonus is rather saturated by Yidhari's Core Passive, but this is more than made up by her Stun DMG Multiplier increase and - if her Signature W-Engine is used - CRIT DMG. Even against Physical Resistant enemies, Dialyn can match or even outpace other Stunners in Daze build, and the ability to convert Yidhari's middling Chain Attack into an Ultimate makes for much smoother and higher damaging combos.
 Manato - Dialyn is by far and away Manato's best Stunner. With his damage distribution being particularly skewed towards Ultimates and in-stun damage, getting a second use of it in stuns is a massive value add. Dialyn does not need to take much field time, but also does not suffer when she happens to be the active character, which means more opportunities to Defensive Assist Manato in for Blazing Heart refresh and resource build. The stun duration increase also makes it easy to fit in a full set of Assist Follow-Ups, being an all-around superior buffer and Stunner than all other options.
 Banyue - As of his release, Dialyn is easily the best Stunner pick for Banyue. Although he does want as much field time as possible, Dialyn isn't so demanding as to take away from his resource generation needs. Her Ultimate conversion - when paired with the stun extension she offers - allows for double Chain and double Ultimate combos, significantly increasing Banyue's burst potential and making it easier to manage his poor Decibel generation.
 Hugo - Dialyn is a particularly strong option for Hugo, with much of her buffs being concentrated in the stun period. While most Hugo teams are dependent on Lighter for best performance, the stun duration extension she provides means she can work as an effective alternative to him. Even if both Lighter's and Dialyn's stun pauses do not stack, their combined buffs are particularly strong, especially as Dialyn offers some of the highest level of Daze build in the game and can boost Hugo's damage by enabling Ultimate use in (almost) every stun. If at M2 Hugo or above, she might just provide the single highest damage increase to any character in the game.
 Evelyn - Dialyn is a near perfect match for Evelyn: she increases Stun DMG Multiplier (where most of Evelyn's damage lands), she extends stun duration (allowing for more Chains in stun) and can convert Chain Attacks to Ultimates (of which Evelyn's is one of the strongest in the game), doing all of this without requiring much field-time. Whether or not she is better than Lighter is up for debate, but she has a very strong case for being a potential best stunner in Evelyn teams.
 Corin Billy Nekomata - All 3 of these Agents benefit massively from Dialyn, as her being a Physical Agent enables their Additional Abilities. Corin and Billy have especially strong Ultimates which synergises well with Dialyn's Ultimate conversion mechanic, and the extra stun duration really helps fit all of their burst in. The ability to use Puffer Electro also means much more consistent performance, as they are no longer reliant on Hormone Punk.
 Anton Ellen Harumasa Zhu Yuan - All other Attackers do very well with Dialyn. Anton's highest damaging attacks are his Chains and Ultimates; Ellen's Potential means her Core Passive applies to her Ultimate as well, and the extended stun duration helps with her long attack animations; Harumasa has a very high scaling Ultimate that more than makes up for it not benefitting from his Core Passive bonuses, so when 2 of them can be used in a combo without sacrificing Dash Attack counts, he has incredibly strong burst; Zhu Yuan has a 4,000%+ damage multiplier Ultimate with fast activation and benefits greatly from Dialyn's fast time to stun, giving her plenty of opportunities to unload.

sections.text:
Below we list only the most important synergies for Dialyn . The character can work with others if you know what to do and how to use them.

 Ye Shunguang - With every Ultimate cast by Ye Shunguang generating 6 Qingming Sword Force points, Dialyn's Ultimate conversion is one of the most accessible ways to get into the Enlightened Mind State. To top it off, the 30% Stun DMG Multiplier increase from Malicious Complaint applies out of stun with Ether Veil: Verdict, meaning that Dialyn's buff offering is not only strong, but consistent. Her low EX Special cost also makes it easy to have King of the Summit buffs up for every burst period, and fast Heavy Attacks allow for easy double Chain Attacks while in Enlightened Mind State if needed. All put together, Dialyn is an invaluable partner who allows Ye Shunguang to be at her best.
 Yixuan - Dialyn is a perfect match for Yixuan teams. In the out of stun period, she has a low field-time commitment, allowing Yixuan to build resources without sacrificing Daze build. When in stun, Dialyn's Stun DMG Multiplier buff and duration extension do wonders at maximising Yixuan's damage output, which is further amplified by her Ultimate conversion, allowing for 3 Yixuan Ultimates in a single stun (2 Decibel, 1 Technique Point). The combination of high Daze, buff value and the raw damage increase that additional Ultimates bring make her among Yixuan's best teammates.
 Yidhari - Dialyn is Yidhari's best Stunner regardless of fight. It is true that Dialyn's DMG Bonus is rather saturated by Yidhari's Core Passive, but this is more than made up by her Stun DMG Multiplier increase and - if her Signature W-Engine is used - CRIT DMG. Even against Physical Resistant enemies, Dialyn can match or even outpace other Stunners in Daze build, and the ability to convert Yidhari's middling Chain Attack into an Ultimate makes for much smoother and higher damaging combos.
 Manato - Dialyn is by far and away Manato's best Stunner. With his damage distribution being particularly skewed towards Ultimates and in-stun damage, getting a second use of it in stuns is a massive value add. Dialyn does not need to take much field time, but also does not suffer when she happens to be the active character, which means more opportunities to Defensive Assist Manato in for Blazing Heart refresh and resource build. The stun duration increase also makes it easy to fit in a full set of Assist Follow-Ups, being an all-around superior buffer and Stunner than all other options.
 Banyue - As of his release, Dialyn is easily the best Stunner pick for Banyue. Although he does want as much field time as possible, Dialyn isn't so demanding as to take away from his resource generation needs. Her Ultimate conversion - when paired with the stun extension she offers - allows for double Chain and double Ultimate combos, significantly increasing Banyue's burst potential and making it easier to manage his poor Decibel generation.
 Hugo - Dialyn is a particularly strong option for Hugo, with much of her buffs being concentrated in the stun period. While most Hugo teams are dependent on Lighter for best performance, the stun duration extension she provides means she can work as an effective alternative to him. Even if both Lighter's and Dialyn's stun pauses do not stack, their combined buffs are particularly strong, especially as Dialyn offers some of the highest level of Daze build in the game and can boost Hugo's damage by enabling Ultimate use in (almost) every stun. If at M2 Hugo or above, she might just provide the single highest damage increase to any character in the game.
 Evelyn - Dialyn is a near perfect match for Evelyn: she increases Stun DMG Multiplier (where most of Evelyn's damage lands), she extends stun duration (allowing for more Chains in stun) and can convert Chain Attacks to Ultimates (of which Evelyn's is one of the strongest in the game), doing all of this without requiring much field-time. Whether or not she is better than Lighter is up for debate, but she has a very strong case for being a potential best stunner in Evelyn teams.
 Corin Billy Nekomata - All 3 of these Agents benefit massively from Dialyn, as her being a Physical Agent enables their Additional Abilities. Corin and Billy have especially strong Ultimates which synergises well with Dialyn's Ultimate conversion mechanic, and the extra stun duration really helps fit all of their burst in. The ability to use Puffer Electro also means much more consistent performance, as they are no longer reliant on Hormone Punk.
 Anton Ellen Harumasa Zhu Yuan - All other Attackers do very well with Dialyn. Anton's highest damaging attacks are his Chains and Ultimates; Ellen's Potential means her Core Passive applies to her Ultimate as well, and the extended stun duration helps with her long attack animations; Harumasa has a very high scaling Ultimate that more than makes up for it not benefitting from his Core Passive bonuses, so when 2 of them can be used in a combo without sacrificing Dash Attack counts, he has incredibly strong burst; Zhu Yuan has a 4,000%+ damage multiplier Ultimate with fast activation and benefits greatly from Dialyn's fast time to stun, giving her plenty of opportunities to unload.

 Pros & Cons
 Pros
 Her Ultimate conversion mechanic is meta-defining, being absurdly strong in its value offering.

 Allows for better combo routes on many teams owing to her stun duration extension.

 Well-rounded buff offering, making her less susceptible to stat saturation.

 Review
 Dialyn is a Physical Stun Agent who can convert other units' Chain Attacks into Ultimates, all the while providing hefty buffs and extending stun durations that allow for brand new combos.
 The bar under her portrait in combat tracks her "Positive Reviews". This has a cap of 120, and regenerates either passively - at a rate of 0.6 seconds - or whenever the Heavy Attack portion of her regular EX Special string hits enemies - at 7.5 per hit. When the gauge reaches 90, it will change colour and stock a "Customer Complaint" point.
 This Customer Complaint point can also be stocked when using an Ultimate, and by holding Basic Attack while one of them is in stock, she will consume it to use her EX Special: Get Lost! - an alternate EX Special that won't use up any Energy and apply a sizable amount of Daze. To keep things simple, this can be referred to as her "Hold Basic EX Special".
 Depending on how many Positive Reviews Dialyn has, different things can happen. If she is under 90, then it will trigger a reverse Quick Assist. If she is at or above 90, then this will forcefully trigger a Chain Attack regardless of the enemy state, so it can be done even when enemies are out of stun!
 After triggering a Chain Attack window (the little menu where you select the next character to Chain Attack with) via certain moves, namely her Quick Assist, Chain Attack or Hold Basic EX Special, she will consume 60 points of Positive Reviews and convert the selected character's Chain Attack into their Decibel Ultimate.
 If the Chain Attack is triggered forcefully through the Hold Basic EX Special (so when enemies are out of stun, or when the stun bar isn't rainbow), then it will consume 90 points instead of 60 for this conversion. It isn’t recommended to do this though, as it can be difficult to keep up with her resource requirements, so try to always use it when there are Chain Attacks left to trigger.
 By constantly using EX Specials to build Daze and Positive Reviews, then triggering Chain Attacks through her Hold Basic EX Specials or other moves, Dialyn can massively increase a team's total damage output by giving them far more Ultimates than they'd otherwise get in a run!
 Core Passive & Additional Ability:
 Dialyn's Core Passive is what encompasses much of what has been covered above: it outlines how she gains Positive Reviews, how she gains Customer Complaint points and the Ultimate conversion effect.
 There are a few extra bits to her Core Passive though. The first is that Dialyn gets 2 Combat Impact for every 1% of CRIT Rate over 50% , maxing out at 100 extra Impact when at 100% CRIT Rate. When coupled with Dialyn's low base Impact, this means that Impact % bonuses - be it from D6 or Stunner W-Engines - are not as good on her as Daze %. Do refer to the Build section for recommendations on this.
 She also applies a 30% Stun DMG Multiplier increase and extends stun durations by 2 seconds when the last hit of her regular EX Special string, "Paper" lands on enemies. This means that most characters don't have to worry about not having the time to fit in multiple Ultimates in a stun window, as Dialyn provides more time with which to land them.
 As for her Additional Ability, it activates on Attack or Rupture Agents, and it increases the CRIT DMG of all her EX Specials by 50%, while also making all of her regular EX Specials deal additional damage based on the preceding character's stats, scaling with the Attack stat for Attackers and Sheer Force for Rupture Agents.
 This means that team order matters for Dialyn, as she does contribute a decent amount of personal damage. Placing her after an Attacker or Rupture Agent is needed to get full benefit, but isn't absolutely necessary to get value out of her.
 The last, and most important part, of her Additional Ability, is a team-wide 40% DMG Bonus after casting her own Ultimate or any of her EX Specials, called "Overwhelmingly Positive". This lasts 15 seconds at first, but if the duration of the buff is under 35 seconds, it can be extended by landing more of them, with each hit increasing it by 10 seconds.
 Special:
 Before covering the rest of her kit, it's important to understand Dialyn's EX Specials.
 There's the aforementioned "Get Lost!", which consumes 1 Customer Complaint point and no Energy, but she also has 3 regular EX Specials. These are the bulk of her Positive Review and Daze build, and cost 25 Energy each.
 They are "Rock", "Scissors" and "Paper", with each linking to the next when cast in succession. They don't need to be used straight away though, as there is an 8 second window to cast the next one. You're free to swap out of Dialyn or use other moves between casts.
 After Rock and Scissors, pressing Basic will let Dialyn link into an alternate Basic Attack. Rock leads to alternate Basics 1 and 2, with Scissors leading to alternate Basics 3 and 4.
 Dialyn's regular Special has very poor stats across the board and is rarely worth using.
 Basic Attack:
 Dialyn's Basic Attacks are rather underwhelming, with unremarkable damage, Daze and Energy values. Her alternate Basic Attacks though (those accessed after regular EX Specials) can be decent.
 A string of:
 EX Special Rock

 Alternate Basic 1 & 2

 EX Special Scissors

 Alternate Basic 3 & 4

 Is an effective way of on-fielding Dialyn. The total Daze build per second she gets from spamming EX Specials vs interspersing them with alternate Basic Attacks isn't very different, but using them can help extend Dialyn's field-time and build a bit of extra Energy.
 Dodge:
 Dialyn's Dodge Counter is alright, but nothing particularly outstanding. It does have decent Energy gain for the time it takes, so it can be used if needing a little extra for an EX Special.
 Assist:
 Despite it being one of the longest Assist Follow-Ups in the game, it also has the highest Daze multiplier as of the time of her release.
 Given how slow it is, you should be mindful of its long animation lock, but the high Daze that it provides makes it a worthwhile option to use if needing Daze and lacking in Energy to sustain EX Specials.
 Her Quick Assist isn't very good, but it is one of the 3 ways that she can activate her Ultimate conversion if it triggers a Chain Attack, so something to keep in mind.
 Chain & Ultimate:
 Dialyn's Chain has rather mediocre damage and isn't particularly fast, but it also isn't terribly slow and has a decent amount of Anomaly application, which can help with Decibel management in fights.
 It is, however, one of the 3 ways that Dialyn can activate her Ultimate conversion and likely to be one of the most commonly used. As long as she isn't the last one to use a Chain Attack, she will trigger a Chain Attack window with it.
 Her Ultimate has the lowest Daze build value out of all Agents at the time of her release and it isn't all that fast either, but it does stock a Customer Complaint point.
 As Dialyn gets a Customer Complaint both from hitting 90 Positive Reviews and from her Ultimate, juggling between them means more uses of her Hold Basic EX Special, which more than makes up for its lacklustre Daze.

 How to play
 Dialyn is a very flexible Agent: she can be played mostly on-field or off-field, so long as you are able to sustain the Energy generation she needs to build Positive Reviews for every stun.
 In simple terms, all that one needs to do is make sure to cast at least one full string of her regular EX Special, so Rock, Scissors and Paper. Landing Paper is very important, as that is how her Stun DMG Multiplier increase and duration extension are applied.
 The earlier she uses an EX Special, the better, as that applies her Overwhelmingly Positive 40% DMG Bonus buff to the whole team. As you can stagger her EX Special casts 8 seconds apart, it's perfectly fine to use an EX Special despite not having the full 75 Energy required for all 3 consecutively, as long as enough can be built before the timer runs out after each cast.
 Once all buffs are up and debuffs are applied, you would split your focus between building enough resources on your main damage dealer (such as Zhu Yuan shotshells, Evelyn Burning Embers, Yixuan Technique Points, etc.) and making sure that Dialyn gets 90 Positive Reviews in time for stun.
 With her Signature W-Engine, she can be mostly kept off-field for its Energy Regeneration bonus and brought in occasionally for EX Specials. Without it, you may need to make use of her alternate Basics between EX Specials to have enough resources.
 Once Stun begins, make sure to use one of the attacks that can trigger the Ultimate conversion to use up her Positive Reviews and go into a stun burst combo.
 The easiest way to achieve this is usually do:
 Trigger a Chain Attack with any character

 Chain Attack on Dialyn

 Chain Attack to your damage dealer (this is upgraded/converted into an Ultimate)

 The more optimal way of initiating stuns though, is through:
 Hold Basic for EX Special: Get Lost!

 Chain Attack to your damage dealer (this is upgraded/converted to an Ultimate)

 Chain Attack on a second character

 Chain Attack on your main damage dealer

 As Ultimates don't count as Chain Attacks, this allows for you to get both an Ultimate conversion and still get your damage dealer's Chain Attack off!
 After the stun ends, it's rinse and repeat. Don't take too long between EX Specials to maintain her 40% DMG Bonus, apply her debuffs with Paper, and keep a close eye on Dialyn's resources so that you have enough Positive Reviews before every stun.

 Teams & Synergy

 Synergy
 Below we list only the most important synergies for Dialyn . The character can work with others if you know what to do and how to use them.

 Ye Shunguang - With every Ultimate cast by Ye Shunguang generating 6 Qingming Sword Force points, Dialyn's Ultimate conversion is one of the most accessible ways to get into the Enlightened Mind State. To top it off, the 30% Stun DMG Multiplier increase from Malicious Complaint applies out of stun with Ether Veil: Verdict, meaning that Dialyn's buff offering is not only strong, but consistent. Her low EX Special cost also makes it easy to have King of the Summit buffs up for every burst period, and fast Heavy Attacks allow for easy double Chain Attacks while in Enlightened Mind State if needed. All put together, Dialyn is an invaluable partner who allows Ye Shunguang to be at her best.
 Yixuan - Dialyn is a perfect match for Yixuan teams. In the out of stun period, she has a low field-time commitment, allowing Yixuan to build resources without sacrificing Daze build. When in stun, Dialyn's Stun DMG Multiplier buff and duration extension do wonders at maximising Yixuan's damage output, which is further amplified by her Ultimate conversion, allowing for 3 Yixuan Ultimates in a single stun (2 Decibel, 1 Technique Point). The combination of high Daze, buff value and the raw damage increase that additional Ultimates bring make her among Yixuan's best teammates.
 Yidhari - Dialyn is Yidhari's best Stunner regardless of fight. It is true that Dialyn's DMG Bonus is rather saturated by Yidhari's Core Passive, but this is more than made up by her Stun DMG Multiplier increase and - if her Signature W-Engine is used - CRIT DMG. Even against Physical Resistant enemies, Dialyn can match or even outpace other Stunners in Daze build, and the ability to convert Yidhari's middling Chain Attack into an Ultimate makes for much smoother and higher damaging combos.
 Manato - Dialyn is by far and away Manato's best Stunner. With his damage distribution being particularly skewed towards Ultimates and in-stun damage, getting a second use of it in stuns is a massive value add. Dialyn does not need to take much field time, but also does not suffer when she happens to be the active character, which means more opportunities to Defensive Assist Manato in for Blazing Heart refresh and resource build. The stun duration increase also makes it easy to fit in a full set of Assist Follow-Ups, being an all-around superior buffer and Stunner than all other options.
 Banyue - As of his release, Dialyn is easily the best Stunner pick for Banyue. Although he does want as much field time as possible, Dialyn isn't so demanding as to take away from his resource generation needs. Her Ultimate conversion - when paired with the stun extension she offers - allows for double Chain and double Ultimate combos, significantly increasing Banyue's burst potential and making it easier to manage his poor Decibel generation.
 Hugo - Dialyn is a particularly strong option for Hugo, with much of her buffs being concentrated in the stun period. While most Hugo teams are dependent on Lighter for best performance, the stun duration extension she provides means she can work as an effective alternative to him. Even if both Lighter's and Dialyn's stun pauses do not stack, their combined buffs are particularly strong, especially as Dialyn offers some of the highest level of Daze build in the game and can boost Hugo's damage by enabling Ultimate use in (almost) every stun. If at M2 Hugo or above, she might just provide the single highest damage increase to any character in the game.
 Evelyn - Dialyn is a near perfect match for Evelyn: she increases Stun DMG Multiplier (where most of Evelyn's damage lands), she extends stun duration (allowing for more Chains in stun) and can convert Chain Attacks to Ultimates (of which Evelyn's is one of the strongest in the game), doing all of this without requiring much field-time. Whether or not she is better than Lighter is up for debate, but she has a very strong case for being a potential best stunner in Evelyn teams.
 Corin Billy Nekomata - All 3 of these Agents benefit massively from Dialyn, as her being a Physical Agent enables their Additional Abilities. Corin and Billy have especially strong Ultimates which synergises well with Dialyn's Ultimate conversion mechanic, and the extra stun duration really helps fit all of their burst in. The ability to use Puffer Electro also means much more consistent performance, as they are no longer reliant on Hormone Punk.
 Anton Ellen Harumasa Zhu Yuan - All other Attackers do very well with Dialyn. Anton's highest damaging attacks are his Chains and Ultimates; Ellen's Potential means her Core Passive applies to her Ultimate as well, and the extended stun duration helps with her long attack animations; Harumasa has a very high scaling Ultimate that more than makes up for it not benefitting from his Core Passive bonuses, so when 2 of them can be used in a combo without sacrificing Dash Attack counts, he has incredibly strong burst; Zhu Yuan has a 4,000%+ damage multiplier Ultimate with fast activation and benefits greatly from Dialyn's fast time to stun, giving her plenty of opportunities to unload.
